steps: Wash cushions and fabric per care labels; let dry fully before storing to prevent mildew.
Wipe down metal/wood/resin frames with mild soap and water.
Apply a protective coating to wood furniture if needed.
Store in a dry shed, garage, or use weatherproof furniture covers if left outside.
Elevate items off the ground slightly to avoid moisture wicking.
